quarterly_data.quarter: Tempus AI press release: Tempus Study Published in Nature Medicine Demonstrates (08-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Tempus announced study results, published in Nature Medicine, showing that PRISM2, a multimodal slide-level pathology foundation model developed in collaboration with researchers from Microsoft, can perform clinically important diagnostic tasks using simple prompts: PRISM2 outperformed or matched existing slide-level foundation models across a comprehensive set of diagnostic, biomarker and patient outcome prediction tasks, and when further tuned to predict long-term outcomes it outperformed standalone models, including achieving high performance predicting colorectal cancer recurrence-free survival. PRISM2 was trained on 2.3 million whole-slide images and 14 million diagnostic question-answer pairs derived from nearly 700,000 pathology reports, which the company calls the largest multimodal slide-level pathology datasets to date (company claim); the full model weights are publicly available through Hugging Face for research and other non-commercial, non-clinical use.
